words.gloss: of the tīrtha-strikers, knot-cutters and raised-hand ones

hindi: तीर्थघात, ग्रन्थिभेद और ऊर्ध्वकरों के प्रथम अपराध में सन्देश का छेदन, अथवा चौवन पण का दण्ड है; दूसरे में छेदन, अथवा सौ पण का दण्ड; तीसरे में दाहिने हाथ का वध, अथवा चार सौ का दण्ड; चौथे में इच्छानुसार वध।
english: For the first offence of the tīrtha-ghātas, granthi-bhedas and ūrdhva-karas: cutting of the sandeśa, or a penalty of fifty-four paṇas; for the second: cutting, or a penalty of a hundred paṇas; for the third: destruction (vadha) of the right hand, or a penalty of four hundred; for the fourth: killing at will.
notes: tīrtha-ghāta, granthi-bheda, ūrdhva-kara are kept as printed (literally 'ford-striking', 'knot-cutting', 'raised-hand'); the compound is read as a dvandva of three offender types, scope uncertain. sandeśa is obscure and kept untranslated (a pair of fingers or the like is a guess, not stated). The object of the second 'chedanaṃ' is not stated. 'paṇasya śatyaḥ' is as printed; read 'a penalty of a hundred paṇas'; the genitive paṇasya is awkward (compare unit 6 'śatyo daṇḍaḥ'). Bare numbers (catuḥ-śataḥ) leave the unit unstated. vadha is rendered 'destruction' for a limb (literally 'striking, killing') and 'killing' alone in the last clause; whose will in 'yathā-kāmī' is not stated.
lines_deva: तीर्थ.घात.ग्रन्थि.भेद.ऊर्ध्व.कराणां प्रथमे ऽपराधे सन्देशच्.छेदनं चतुष्.पञ्चाशत्.पणो वा दण्डः, द्वितीये छेदनं पणस्य शत्यो वा दण्डः, तृतीये दक्षिण.हस्त.वधश् चतुः.शतो वा दण्डः, चतुर्थे यथा.कामी वधः
lines_iast: tīrtha.ghāta.granthi.bheda.ūrdhva.karāṇāṃ prathame 'parādhe sandeśac.chedanaṃ catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇo vā daṇḍaḥ, dvitīye chedanaṃ paṇasya śatyo vā daṇḍaḥ, tṛtīye dakṣiṇa.hasta.vadhaś catuḥ.śato vā daṇḍaḥ, caturthe yathā.kāmī vadhaḥ

words.gloss: in those of twenty-five paṇas or lower
in thefts of fowl, mongoose, cat, dog, pig
cutting of the tip of the nose

hindi: पच्चीस पण या उससे कम वाले मामलों में मुर्गे, नेवले, बिल्ली, कुत्ते और सूअर की चोरी या हिंसा में चौवन पण का दण्ड है, अथवा नाक के अग्र भाग का छेदन; चाण्डालों और वनचरों के दण्ड आधे हैं।
english: In cases of twenty-five paṇas or lower, for theft of fowl, mongoose, cat, dog or pig, or for injury [to them], the penalty is fifty-four paṇas, or cutting of the tip of the nose; for caṇḍālas and forest-goers the penalties [are] half.
notes: 'avara' in pañca-viṃśati-paṇa-avareṣu is ambiguous: 'lower/lesser' (so up to 25 paṇas, the sense used) or 'at the lowest' (at least 25); the sense of the context (small penalties) favours the first but it is not certain. The animals injured are not named in hiṃsāyām; '[to them]' is supplied. araṇya-cara is literally 'forest-goer'. The copula in the last clause is supplied.
lines_deva: पञ्च.विंशति.पण.अवरेषु कुक्कुट.नकुल.मार्जार.श्व.सूकर.स्तेयेषु हिंसायां वा चतुष्.पञ्चाशत्.पणो दण्डः, नास.अग्रच्.छेदनं वा- चण्डाल.अरण्य.चराणाम् अर्ध.दण्डाः
lines_iast: pañca.viṃśati.paṇa.avareṣu kukkuṭa.nakula.mārjāra.śva.sūkara.steyeṣu hiṃsāyāṃ vā catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, nāsa.agrac.chedanaṃ vā- caṇḍāla.araṇya.carāṇām ardha.daṇḍāḥ

words.gloss: in snares, nets, traps and pitfalls
of deer, animals, birds, beasts of prey, fish

hindi: फंदों, जालों, कूटों और गड्ढों में बँधे हुए मृग, पशु, पक्षी, व्याल और मछलियों को ले लेने में वह और उतना दण्ड है।
english: For taking deer, animals, birds, beasts of prey and fish bound in snares, nets, traps and pitfalls, the penalty is that and as much.
notes: The referent of 'tat' is not stated (commentators take the value of what was taken, with an equal amount as the penalty); the translation stays literal. vyāla may also mean snake; 'beast of prey' is the usual sense. kūṭa 'trap' and avapāta 'pitfall' are the plain senses; the four-member split could differ (kūṭa-avapāta as one).
lines_deva: पाश.जाल.कूट.अवपातेषु बद्धानां मृग.पशु.पक्षि.व्याल.मत्स्यानाम् आदाने तच् च तावच् च दण्डः
lines_iast: pāśa.jāla.kūṭa.avapāteṣu baddhānāṃ mṛga.paśu.pakṣi.vyāla.matsyānām ādāne tac ca tāvac ca daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: from the forest of animals and materials
in the removal of animals and materials

hindi: मृग और द्रव्य के वन से मृग और द्रव्य के अपहरण में सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For the removal of animals and materials from the forest of animals and materials, the penalty is of a hundred.

text_flags.why: possible typo: long ā; the same word is printed śatyo in units 1 and 6

notes: mṛga-dravya-vana is read literally; it may stand for two forests (game forest and produce forest), not stated here. Unit not stated for 'a hundred'.
lines_deva: मृग.द्रव्य.वनान् मृग.द्रव्य.अपहारे शात्यो दण्डः
lines_iast: mṛga.dravya.vanān mṛga.dravya.apahāre śātyo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: in theft of the deer and birds of the bimba-vihāra

hindi: बिम्बविहार के मृगों और पक्षियों की चोरी या हिंसा में दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: For theft of, or injury to, the deer and birds of the bimba-vihāra, the penalty is twofold.
notes: bimba is obscure and kept untranslated; vihāra is 'amusement' (so possibly a pleasure-ground), but the compound is left as printed. The grouping bimba-vihāra + mṛga-pakṣi is a guess; injury 'to them' is not stated. 'Twofold' of what is not stated in the line (no figure is given); nothing is supplied.
lines_deva: बिम्ब.विहार.मृग.पक्षि.स्तेये हिंसायां वा द्वि.गुणो दण्डः
lines_iast: bimba.vihāra.mṛga.pakṣi.steye hiṃsāyāṃ vā dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of artisans, craftsmen, kuśīlavas and ascetics
in the removal of small goods
in the removal of coarse goods
in the removal of goods of farming

hindi: कारु, शिल्पी, कुशीलव और तपस्वियों के छोटे द्रव्यों के अपहरण में सौ का दण्ड है, मोटे द्रव्यों के अपहरण में दो सौ का, और कृषि के द्रव्य के अपहरण में —
english: For the removal of the small goods of artisans, craftsmen, kuśīlavas and ascetics, the penalty is of a hundred; for the removal of coarse goods, of two hundred; and for the removal of goods of farming —
notes: The sentence is left open as printed: the penalty for kṛṣi-dravya-apahāra is not stated (possibly continuing the previous figure or the next unit's context). kuśīlava is kept untranslated as in the glossary. sthūlaka 'large' (literally 'coarse, big'). Review: sthūlaka rendered 'coarse' (glossary 4.1), 'large' only as a possible sense.
lines_deva: कारु.शिल्पि.कुशीलव.तपस्विनां क्षुद्रक.द्रव्य.अपहारे शत्यो दण्डः, स्थूलक.द्रव्य.अपहारे द्वि.शतः, कृषि.द्रव्य.अपहारे च
lines_iast: kāru.śilpi.kuśīlava.tapasvināṃ kṣudraka.dravya.apahāre śatyo daṇḍaḥ, sthūlaka.dravya.apahāre dvi.śataḥ, kṛṣi.dravya.apahāre ca

words.gloss: of one whose entry has not been made

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. pra-√viś

words.gloss: from a hole in the rampart

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. apa-√sṛ

hindi: जो दुर्ग में प्रवेश करता है और जिसका प्रवेश किया नहीं गया, अथवा परकोटे के छेद से प्रवेश करता है, जो धरोहर लेकर हट जाता है, उसका काण्डरा-वध अथवा दो सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who enters a fort without his entry having been made, or through a hole in the rampart, of one who goes away having taken a deposit: destruction of the kāṇḍarā, or a penalty of two hundred.

text_flags.why: possible typo: long ā; compare dvi.śataḥ in unit 6

notes: akṛta-praveśa ('whose entry has not been made') is taken literally; the sense may be 'without leave to enter'. The grouping of the clauses is uncertain: the translation takes (a) entering the fort without entry made, or through a hole in the rampart, and (b) going away with a deposit; the ablative prākāra-chidrāt is rendered 'through'. kāṇḍarā is obscure and kept untranslated (a sinew or tendon is a guess). Review: the ablative prākāra-chidrāt could equally belong with apasarataḥ (going away through a hole in the rampart with a deposit); the grouping stays open and confidence low.
lines_deva: दुर्गम् अकृत.प्रवेशस्य प्रविशतः प्राकारच्.छिद्राद् वा निक्षेपं गृहीत्वा-अपसरतः काण्डरा.वधो, द्वि.शातो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: durgam akṛta.praveśasya praviśataḥ prākārac.chidrād vā nikṣepaṃ gṛhītvā-apasarataḥ kāṇḍarā.vadho, dvi.śāto vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. apa-√hṛ

hindi: पहियों से युक्त को, नाव को या छोटे पशु को चुराने वाले का एक पैर का वध अथवा तीन सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who steals what is fitted with wheels, a boat, or a small animal: destruction of one foot, or a penalty of three hundred.
notes: cakra-yuktam has no noun in the text (a wheeled vehicle is meant if anything, not stated); it is rendered 'what is fitted with wheels'. The alternative is 'a boat fitted with wheels'.
lines_deva: चक्र.युक्तं नावं क्षुद्र.पशुं वा-अपहरत एक.पाद.वधः, त्रि.शतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: cakra.yuktaṃ nāvaṃ kṣudra.paśuṃ vā-apaharata eka.pāda.vadhaḥ, tri.śato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of one who makes unevenness with false kākaṇī, akṣa, arālā, śalākā or hand

hindi: झूठे काकणी, अक्ष, अराला, शलाका या हाथ से विषमता करने वाले का एक हाथ का वध अथवा चार सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who makes unevenness with false kākaṇī, akṣa, arālā, śalākā or hand: destruction of one hand, or a penalty of four hundred.
notes: The compound is only partly clear: kākaṇī (a small coin or weight) and arālā are kept as printed (arālā is obscure); akṣa is 'die' or 'weight'; śalākā 'rod'. Whether kūṭa 'false' governs every member is uncertain. viṣama-kārin is rendered literally ('one who makes unevenness'), the sense 'cheat' is not stated. The case of the first token is ambiguous (gen. sg. or nom. pl.); the genitive is taken.
lines_deva: कूट.काकण्य्.अक्ष.अराला.शलाका.हस्त.विषम.कारिण एक.हस्त.वधः, चतुः.शतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: kūṭa.kākaṇy.akṣa.arālā.śalākā.hasta.viṣama.kāriṇa eka.hasta.vadhaḥ, catuḥ.śato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of a thief and an adulterer
of one who has been seized

hindi: चोर और परस्त्रीगामी के सहायता-कर्म में स्त्री का और पकड़ी हुई स्त्री का कान और नाक का छेदन अथवा पाँच सौ का दण्ड है; पुरुष का दुगुना।
english: For the act of assisting a thief and an adulterer: for a woman, and for one [f.] who has been seized, cutting of ears and nose, or a penalty of five hundred; for a man, twofold.

text_flags.why: possible typo: the genitive of puṃs is puṃsaḥ, with s not ṣ

notes: saṅgṛhītā is rendered literally 'one who has been seized' (alternatives: taken in hand, kept); whether it is a second class of woman or a qualifier of 'striyāḥ' is uncertain. pāradārika is taken as 'adulterer' (literally 'one who approaches another's wife').
lines_deva: स्तेन.पारदारिकयोः साचिव्य.कर्मणि स्त्रियाः सङ्गृहीतायाश् च कर्ण.नासाच्.छेदनम्, पञ्च.शतो वा दण्डः, पुंषो द्वि.गुणः
lines_iast: stena.pāradārikayoḥ sācivya.karmaṇi striyāḥ saṅgṛhītāyāś ca karṇa.nāsāc.chedanam, pañca.śato vā daṇḍaḥ, puṃṣo dvi.guṇaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. apa-√hṛ
pres. part. m. gen. sg. vi-√krī

hindi: एक महापशु, दास या दासी को चुराने वाले का, अथवा मृतक का भाण्ड बेचने वाले का दो पैरों का वध अथवा छह सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who steals a single large animal, a male slave or a female slave, or who sells the goods of the deceased: destruction of two feet, or a penalty of six hundred.
notes: 'ekam' may qualify only mahā-paśum, or the whole list ('even one'); the translation takes it with the first item. bhāṇḍa is rendered 'goods' (utensils or vessels also possible). The text has two offences with one penalty.
lines_deva: महा.पशुम् एकं दासं दासीं वा-अपहरतः प्रेत.भाण्डं वा विक्रीणानस्य द्वि.पाद.वधः, षट्.छतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: mahā.paśum ekaṃ dāsaṃ dāsīṃ vā-apaharataḥ preta.bhāṇḍaṃ vā vikrīṇānasya dvi.pāda.vadhaḥ, ṣaṭ.chato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: in overstepping with hand and foot
in mounting the king's conveyance, mount and so on
destruction of one hand and foot

hindi: श्रेष्ठ वर्णों और गुरुजनों का हाथ-पैर से उल्लंघन करने में, और राजा के यान, वाहन आदि पर चढ़ने में, एक हाथ-पैर का वध अथवा सात सौ का दण्ड है।
english: For overstepping with hand and foot [against] those of the highest varṇas and elders, and for mounting the king's conveyance, mount and so on: destruction of one hand and foot, or a penalty of seven hundred.
notes: laṅghana is literally 'leaping over, transgressing'; the sense (e.g. striking) is not stated and the translation stays literal. 'eka-hasta-pāda' may mean 'one hand and foot' (used) or 'one hand or foot'. '[against]' is supplied for the genitives. varṇa-uttama is taken as 'highest varṇa'.
lines_deva: वर्ण.उत्तमानां गुरूणां च हस्त.पाद.लङ्घने राज.यान.वाहन.आद्य्.आरोहणे च-एक.हस्त.पाद.वधः, सप्त.शतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: varṇa.uttamānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca hasta.pāda.laṅghane rāja.yāna.vāhana.ādy.ārohaṇe ca-eka.hasta.pāda.vadhaḥ, sapta.śato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. ava-√stṛ
pres. part. m. gen. sg. ā-√diś

hindi: ब्राह्मण के रूप में बोलने वाले शूद्र का, देवता के द्रव्य को ढकने वाले का, राजा के द्वेष्य को कहने वाले का और दोनों आँखें फोड़ने वाले का योग-अञ्जन से अन्धापन अथवा आठ सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of a śūdra who speaks as a brāhmaṇa, of one who covers the property of a god, of one who declares what is hated by the king, and of one who breaks both eyes: blindness by a compound añjana, or a penalty of eight hundred.
notes: brāhmaṇa-vādin is literal ('speaking as/of a brāhmaṇa'), perhaps 'claims to be a brāhmaṇa'. avastṛṇataḥ (ava-√stṛ) is literally 'covering, spreading over'; the sense (concealing, misappropriating) is uncertain, as is ādiśataḥ (declaring, pointing out, prescribing). yoga-añjana: yoga is 'compound' (a prepared combination) following the glossary entries for Book 14; the Book 4 sense is not settled. añjana is a salve or collyrium. Review: yoga = compound is kept to match the 4.4 settlement for medicinal combinations (madana-yoga); sense for Book 4 still a person's decision.
lines_deva: शूद्रस्य ब्राह्मण.वादिनो देव.द्रव्यम् अवस्तृणतो राज.द्विष्टम् आदिशतो द्वि.नेत्र.भेदिनश् च योग.अञ्जनेन-अन्धत्वम्, अष्ट.शतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: śūdrasya brāhmaṇa.vādino deva.dravyam avastṛṇato rāja.dviṣṭam ādiśato dvi.netra.bhedinaś ca yoga.añjanena-andhatvam, aṣṭa.śato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. √muc
pres. part. m. gen. sg. apa-√hṛ

words.gloss: destruction of the left hand and two feet

hindi: चोर या परस्त्रीगामी को छुड़ाने वाले का, राजा के आदेश को कम या अधिक लिखने वाले का, कन्या या दासी को धन सहित चुराने वाले का, कपटपूर्ण व्यवहार करने वाले का और विमांस बेचने वाले का बायें हाथ और दोनों पैरों का वध अथवा नौ सौ का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who sets free a thief or an adulterer, of one who writes a royal order deficient or excessive, of one who steals a girl or a female slave together with [her] money, of one who deals fraudulently, and of a seller of vimāṃsa: destruction of the left hand and two feet, or a penalty of nine hundred.

text_flags.why: typo: ra and ha transposed; apa-√hṛ 'steal', as apaharataḥ in units 8 and 11

notes: vimāṃsa is obscure and kept untranslated (vi- may be 'bad' or 'without'; the meaning is not stated). 'sa-hiraṇyam' (sa + hiraṇyam, unsandhied join) is taken with kanyām dāsīm (hiraṇya = money in the glossary). The list has five offences under one penalty. mokṣayataḥ is literally 'causing to be freed'; '[her]' is supplied in English.
lines_deva: चोरं पारदारिकं वा मोक्षयतो राज.शासनम् ऊनम् अतिरिक्तं वा लिखतः कन्यां दासीं वा स-हिरण्यम् अपरहतः कूट.व्यवहारिणो विमांस.विक्रयिणश् च वाम.हस्त.द्वि.पाद.वधो, नव.शतो वा दण्डः
lines_iast: coraṃ pāradārikaṃ vā mokṣayato rāja.śāsanam ūnam atiriktaṃ vā likhataḥ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ vā sa-hiraṇyam aparahataḥ kūṭa.vyavahāriṇo vimāṃsa.vikrayiṇaś ca vāma.hasta.dvi.pāda.vadho, nava.śato vā daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: in the sale of human flesh

hindi: मनुष्य के मांस की बिक्री में वध है।
english: For the sale of human flesh: killing.
notes: vadha here is the whole penalty, rendered 'killing'; in limb compounds it is 'destruction'.
lines_deva: मानुष.मांस.विक्रये वधः
lines_iast: mānuṣa.māṃsa.vikraye vadhaḥ

words.gloss: of one who steals gods, animals, images, persons, fields, houses, money, gold, jewels, crops

hindi: देव, पशु, प्रतिमा, मनुष्य, क्षेत्र, गृह, धन, सोना, रत्न और फसल को चुराने वाले का सर्वोच्च दण्ड है, अथवा शुद्ध वध।
english: Of one who steals gods, animals, images, persons, fields, houses, money, gold, jewels or crops: the highest penalty, or plain killing.
notes: The first members are ambiguous: 'deva' may qualify the next ('god's animals, god's images') rather than stand alone; the list is rendered as a plain dvandva. 'uttama' is the highest penalty, not otherwise defined here. śuddha-vadha is literally 'pure killing' (plain execution is a guess).
lines_deva: देव.पशु.प्रतिमा.मनुष्य.क्षेत्र.गृह.हिरण्य.सुवर्ण.रत्न.सस्य.अपहारिण उत्तमो दण्डः, शुद्ध.वधो वा
lines_iast: deva.paśu.pratimā.manuṣya.kṣetra.gṛha.hiraṇya.suvarṇa.ratna.sasya.apahāriṇa uttamo daṇḍaḥ, śuddha.vadho vā

hindi: पुरुष और अपराध, कारण, गुरुता और लघुता, अनुबन्ध और तात्कालिक, तथा देश और काल पर विचार करके —
english: Having considered the person and the offence, the cause, the heaviness and lightness, the sequel and the immediate, and place and time —
notes: The sentence continues in unit 18, whose main verb is kalpayet; the last 'ca' is not rendered separately. tadātva/anubandha follow the glossary (the immediate/the sequel). Correction: all four ca are rendered; the statement that the last ca is not rendered separately is wrong.
lines_deva: पुरुषं च-अपराधं च कारणं गुरु.लाघवम्
अनुबन्धं तदात्वं च देश.कालौ समीक्ष्य च
lines_iast: puruṣaṃ ca-aparādhaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ guru.lāghavam
anubandhaṃ tadātvaṃ ca deśa.kālau samīkṣya ca

hindi: दण्ड-कर्म में प्रदेष्टा, राजा और प्रकृतियों के बीच स्थित होकर, सर्वोच्चता, निम्नता और मध्यमता निर्धारित करे।
english: The pradeṣṭṛ, standing between the king and the constituent elements, should fix being highest, lowest or middle in the action of penalty.
notes: prakṛtīnām follows the glossary ('constituent element'); here it may mean the subjects or people, an interpretation not stated. 'uttama-avara-madhyatva' refers to the grade of punishment (the highest, lowest and middle), not stated in the line. pradeṣṭṛ stays as in the glossary. The sentence begins in unit 17.
lines_deva: उत्तम.अवर.मध्यत्वं प्रदेष्टा दण्ड.कर्मणि
राज्ञश् च प्रकृतीनां च कल्पयेद् अन्तरा स्थितः
lines_iast: uttama.avara.madhyatvaṃ pradeṣṭā daṇḍa.karmaṇi
rājñaś ca prakṛtīnāṃ ca kalpayed antarā sthitaḥ
